items.title: Darnell Howard Interview, 1957-04-21
items.q: What? Mike the Pike Hitler. He had a place called Wakeworm, 119th and Wood

ctx.x: It didn't bother us. I forget the time Mike the Pike Hitler. What? Mike the Pike Hitler. He had a place called Wakeworm, 119th and Wood, way out south in Chicago. And they got to shooting in there one night. They asked where the band was after the shooting. Hell, I was home. I was.
I don't think anybody else did either. I'm trying to leave.
